title: finding(app-shell): Studio's nav-item inspector shows a locale-map label as "[object Object]", and one keystroke writes a plain string over the whole map
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a), loss of authored metadata. `reach:` a public door, measured. The objectui#11128 dev ran an uncommitted probe at PR objectui#11146's head `9d2fb10d8`. It rendered the Studio app pillar's nav-item inspector (`StudioNavItemInspector`) with `label: { en: 'Accounts', 'zh-CN': '客户' }`. The Label input showed `[object Object]`, and one keystroke wrote the plain string `Customers` over the whole map, so the `zh-CN` text was lost.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11146 (objectui#11128), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]`. That PR's contract review (`5899177331`, ③ c) confirmed it at the head, in the same family as objectui#11128, and asked for a sibling card. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `385ebc5c6`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)

- `StudioNavItemInspector` (`:1426`) reads `const curLabel = String(node.label ?? node.title ?? node.name ?? '')` (`:1464`), so a map becomes `[object Object]`. It also reads `title` and `name`, which are not nav-item keys.
- The Label input writes `patch({ label: e.target.value })`, which replaces a map with a string.
- The inspector is rendered beside the app designer's canvas in the Studio app pillar. After PR objectui#11146 the canvas keeps a map on rename while this inspector, next to it, still deletes it.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

This is objectui#11128's rule, applied to the second editor of the same label:
- Display resolves through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel(label, locale)` in the designer locale.
- An edit writes the designer locale's entry of a map and keeps every other entry, using the same key choice as PR objectui#11146's `renamedLabel` (exact tag, else bare language, else a new exact-tag entry), ideally by sharing that helper so the two editors cannot disagree.
- A plain-string label stays a string.
- `title` / `name` are not read as a label.

Pins: a map label shows the resolved text under en and zh; an edit under zh changes only `zh-CN`; a plain string edits as today.

Serial: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is also objectui#11136's file (the Interfaces pillar's inspectors), a different component in the same file.

## Dedupe

The 1170 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were grepped:
- `StudioNavItemInspector`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11146 (the source).
- `curLabel`: 0 hits.
- `[object Object]` near "nav": 5 hits, all the preview / canvas family (objectui#11100 / #11127, #11098, #11146) or a timeline lookup (PR objectui#10593). None is this inspector.
